title: Rust project goals: Immobile types and guaranteed destructors
summary: This is a Rust language RFC proposal for introducing a 'move trait' that would enable immobile types which cannot be moved after construction, along with guaranteed destructors. The proposal addresses long-standing limitations in Rust's ownership system for use cases like FFI, self-referential structures, and memory pinning.
problem_solved: Rust currently lacks a standardized mechanism to prevent types from being moved in memory, which is needed for safe FFI interop, self-referential data structures, and pinning.
why_valuable: This proposal would unlock new patterns for systems programming in Rust, enabling safer memory management, better FFI compatibility, and more ergonomic handling of pinned data without relying on unsafe code.
